title: Suisei no Gargantia OVA
justification: AniList 19211 (OVA, 2 episode(s) from 2013-08-28) is AniDB 9556's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2013-08-09 and 2013-10-25. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 16524, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 9556, and AniDB lists MAL 19211 on AniDB 9556. TVDB 267432 0x15 'Abandoned Fleet' and 0x16 'Altar of the Visitor from Afar' carry the same titles and the same dates.
